integrity: All formulas are derived explicitly. Finite checker runs are supplementary and not a proof; an independent audit has not been performed. Historical novelty is literature-bounded, not certified.
scientific_limitations: Only a stationary linear, laterally uniform midplane-emission slab, two Robin deposition surfaces, strictly positive constant transport and removal rates, and precisely surface-to-volume-matched global removal. Risk inference is for fixed-height, sufficiently long exposure only; no empirical validation or arbitrary geometry is claimed.
title: Sharp height-dependent reversal of matched bulk and surface deposition in an indoor aerosol slab
